Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pen test and remediation evidence for procurement gating

Hi Jordan,

We're finalizing the SOW/MAP and procurement needs the following security evidence before the contract signature window (target: 2026-07-21):
- Most recent penetration test report (we understand redacted versions are acceptable; please indicate redaction scope)
- Remediation status for any findings marked High/Critical (CVE references or tracker IDs accepted)
- SOC 2 type II attestation (if available) or SIG questionnaire response

Could you confirm by EOD 2026-07-12 whether you can provide a redacted pen test PDF and a remediation matrix, and where we should upload these documents? The procurement portal will accept a link or an emailed package.

Thanks,
Elena Cruz
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health Systems

Attachment: none

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test and remediation evidence for procurement gating

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list and the deadline. Short answers up front: yes, we can provide a redacted penetration test report and a remediation status matrix by 2026-07-15, and we will supply a short attestation letter from our security leadership if needed for the MAP.

Plan:
- Today: confirm redaction approach (we will remove internal IPs, customer-identifying data, and team comments; we will preserve vulnerability IDs, severity, and remediation notes).
- 2026-07-14: deliver redacted PDF + remediation matrix (XLSX) to the drive link or upload to your procurement portal (you tell us preference).
- 2026-07-14–15: provide a 1-page attestation letter signed by our VP Security if procurement requires a signature.

I am cc'ing Marissa (security lead) and Sergio (CS lead) so they can prepare the artifacts and the remediation matrix for the specific Acme findings. If procurement needs any specific format for the remediation tracker (columns, status codes), please share and we'll adapt.

Next steps for you: confirm upload preference (Drive link or direct portal upload) and whether the attestation needs to be on company letterhead and signed via DocuSign.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0142

Attachment (planned): RI-pen-test-2025-redacted.pdf (stub), remediation-matrix-AcmeHealth-20260714.xlsx (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pen test and remediation evidence for procurement gating

Jordan / Sergio — forwarding for action. Quick notes from SecOps: we ran the external pen test Nov 2025; the full report contains detailed exploitation steps and customer identifiers that we must redact. Our redaction policy keeps CVE IDs, CWE, severity, affected component, and remediation guidance. We will NOT redact CVE identifiers or remediation status.

Status on findings relevant to Acme:
- CRIT-2025-001 (RCE in inference runtime): remediated in 2026-02-28, patch v1.3.4 deployed to hosted and dedicated pools (ticket INF-4781).
- HIGH-2025-007 (auth bypass in admin API): mitigation applied (WAF rule + ACL) and scheduled full fix in v1.4.0 (ETA 2026-08-05).
- MEDIUM items: work in progress; none are blockers for production contracts.

I'll assemble the remediation-matrix-AcmeHealth-20260714.xlsx with columns: finding_id, cve/cwe, severity, status, remediation_date, fix_reference, notes. We'll include links to internal tickets (INF-xxxx). Jordan — I'll mark the matrix with which items we consider fully remediated vs mitigated.

Marissa
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
